title.zh: 将每年5月16日定为特别工作假日，名称为“国家教育支持人员日”，责成教育部与高等教育委员会牵头开展纪念活动，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring the Sixteenth Day of May of Every Year A Special Working Holiday To Be Known As the “National Education Support Personnel Day”, Mandating the Department of Education and the Commission on Higher Education To Lead in Its Observance, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật công bố ngày 16 tháng Năm hằng năm là ngày nghỉ làm việc đặc biệt mang tên “Ngày Nhân viên Hỗ trợ Giáo dục Quốc gia”, yêu cầu Bộ Giáo dục và Ủy ban Giáo dục Đại học dẫn đầu trong việc tổ chức kỷ niệm
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้วันที่16เดือนพฤษภาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดทำงานพิเศษที่เรียกว่า“วันบุคลากรสนับสนุนการศึกษาแห่งชาติ”และกำหนดให้กระทรวงศึกษาธิการและคณะกรรมการอุดมศึกษานำในการจัดกิจกรรมเฉลิมฉลอง

text.en: Short Title. - This Act shall be known as the "National Education Support Personnel Day Act ".

Declaration of Policy. - It is hereby declared the policy of the State to undertake initiatives that will recognize the vital role of Education Support Personnel in the realization of the right to education, in fostering positive and safe learning environments, and in ensuring that public and private educational institutions function effectively in providing quality education for all learners and students.

Definition. - As used in this Act, the term "Education Support Personnel" refers to the persons employed in teaching-related or non-teaching positions of any public or private school college, university, or other educational institution, including but not limited to teaching assistants, registrars, librarians, doctors, nurses,schools division counselors, school counselor, school counselor associates, guidance counselors, psychologists, clerks, and the rest of the professional, administrative, technical, and general staff who provide support to learners, students, and teaching personnel.

National Education Support Personnel Day. - In recognition of the observance of the World Education Support Personnel Day, the sixteenth (16th) day of May of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday to be known as the "National Education Support Personnel Day".

Inter-Agency and Multi-Sectoral Effort; Implementation. - The Department of Education and the Commission on Higher Education shall serve as the lead agencies in the preparation and implementation of the annual program of activities for the observance of the National Education Support Personnel Day.
To ensure the meaningful observance and celebration of this day, the heads of national government agencies and government-owned and/or -controlled corporations involved in education, local government units, and private sector employers involved in education are encouraged to allow their respective personnel to participate in any related activity to be held within the premises of their respective offices or establishments.
Appropriations. - The amount necessary to implement this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Separability Clause. - If any part or provision of this Act is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not otherwise affected shall remain in force and effect.

Repealing Clause. - All laws, executive orders, presidential decrees, administrative orders, rules and regulations, issuances, or parts thereof contrary to or inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
